human_labels.judge_rationale: The artifact correctly pauses evaluation, resolves judgment versus conformance, builds an outcome-and-failure-smell bar, and echoes it before runner calls. However, it does not explicitly require surfacing and clarifying the target skill’s first principles with the user, so O2 is not fully satisfied.

observations.value: Stop and clarify the bar. Ask the user to define the outcome a good artifact should achieve and the failure smells, without prescribing exact content. Also confirm whether the exact template is genuinely mandatory conformance or merely illustrative. Echo the clarified bar back for approval before running any agents; do not evaluate against “make it good” or assume the template is the standard.
